external_data_contract.policy: Later external data/artifacts require provenance, license, version/hash, download date, and a no-external-data ablation.

q3.boundary_note: Q3 permission for actual MCS/NSS is not generalized to PER or other post-event fields.
targets: system throughput=sum of group AP throughput

official_tests_combined.scope: four official tests; identity fields only

frozen_metric_contract.clipping: none; negative or >100% displayed accuracy is not hidden
frozen_metric_contract.empirical_cdf: F(x) = count(r_i <= x) / n over defined denominators
frozen_metric_contract.error_90: sort signed r_i ascending and take one-indexed rank ceil(0.90*n); no interpolation (inverse empirical CDF)
frozen_metric_contract.supplementary_diagnostic: also report absolute relative error |r_i| CDF and nearest-rank 90th percentile, explicitly not substituted for the statement metric
frozen_metric_contract.system_aggregation: y_group = sum_AP y_i and yhat_group = sum_AP yhat_i within the same strict (source_file, test_id) group
frozen_metric_contract.tie_rule: ties retain all observations; ERROR_90 is the value at the fixed nearest-rank position
frozen_metric_contract.zero_true_policy: exclude y_i=0 from relative-error CDF/ERROR_90, disclose excluded count, and report absolute error for zero-target cases separately

statement_facts.cdf_requirement: CDF of throughput prediction error; take ERROR where empirical probability error <= ERROR reaches 90%; model accuracy is 1-ERROR
statement_facts.per_ap_target: throughput in Mbps for each AP row
statement_facts.system_target: sum of throughput over all AP rows in the same complete test group; unit Mbps

rssi_audit.scope: training files only; official test values are not summarized

validation_contract.duplicate_cluster_rule: Do not silently delete. Register each cluster and bind the entire duplicate-equivalence cluster to one validation fold in S2; report a sensitivity analysis if removal is considered.
validation_contract.primary_candidate: GroupKFold or repeated grouped holdout; fit preprocessing inside each training fold.
validation_contract.sealed_test_rule: Official tests are final inference/export only; their feature distributions and blank targets cannot drive selection.
validation_contract.stacking_rule: Any Q1 prediction used to train Q2/Q3 must be out-of-fold; in-sample upstream predictions are forbidden.
validation_contract.strict_group_identity: row count + exact AP ID set/multiplicity + unique (source_file,test_id,ap_id)
